Package org.lwjgl.vulkan

@NullMarked package org.lwjgl.vulkan
Contains bindings to Vulkan, a new generation graphics and compute API that provides high-efficiency, cross-platform access to modern GPUs used in a wide variety of devices from PCs and consoles to mobile phones and embedded platforms.

Experimental extensions (KHX, NVX, etc) is not supported API. When such an extension is promoted to stable, the corresponding experimental bindings will be removed.

macOS: LWJGL bundles MoltenVK, which emulates Vulkan over Metal.
